name: human-away
description: Read-only-visible Away mode state chip (chat pane + input row) driven by the AGENTS.md STATUS token.

commands.title: Human Away: Shift Status Chip Left
Human Away: Shift Status Chip Right

humanAway.agentsFile.markdownDescription: Truth-source file holding the `[STATUS: ON|OFF]` token (POSIX, UNC or `~` path).

humanAway.heading.markdownDescription: Exact heading line the parser anchors on in the truth file. Update it here if the rule is renamed; the `[STATUS: ON|OFF]` token must stay on that line.

humanAway.position.description: ONE active placement of the chip. Falls back to statusBarLeft (visible in status command) when the chat-area API is unavailable.

humanAway.style.description: V2 colored dot + word (default) or V5 outlined badge. Identical everywhere, every state.

humanAway.refreshSeconds.description: Max refresh staleness (seconds); watcher is primary, stat-only poll the guard.

humanAway.pendingGraceSeconds.description: Window showing the switching color after a token change.

humanAway.scopeMode.description: global: the token file is the state. window: file seeds, per-window overrides until the file changes.

humanAway.preferNativeChatChip.description: Use the chat-input status item (OptionsLocation) when the running VS Code exposes it.

humanAway.showSessionScope.description: Show the focused workspace SESSION.md first lines in the tooltip.

humanAway.statusBarPriority.description: Order of the status-bar chip relative to other items (higher = further left). Use the Shift chip left/right commands for stepwise adjustment.

humanAway.sessionHeadLines.description: Number of SESSION.md head lines shown in the tooltip session scope.

enumDescriptions: GitHub Copilot Chat interactive question UI (chips above the Chat input)
Plain numbered question in chat prose
humanAway.arbitrationChannel.markdownDescription: Channel the agent MUST use for arbitrations. Binding via the agents memory rule, which reads this value from settings.json only - never from AGENTS.md content at run time.

humanAway.forceInteractiveArbitration.markdownDescription: ON: an autopilot auto-answer (class A, e.g. "user not available") never counts as an arbitration answer; the interactive UI reopens until a real answer. OFF: a class-A answer is accepted as a fall-back decision.

humanAway.awayMaxRequests.markdownDescription: While Away mode is ON, `chat.agent.maxRequests` (GitHub Copilot Chat) is temporarily raised to this value so long unattended runs never pause with "Copilot has been working on this problem for a while… Continue to iterate?". The value 100000 covers a full day of uninterrupted tool requests (~5 s/request ≈ 17 000; VS Code accepts no greater-than setting, so no upper bound applies). When Away goes OFF the previous value is restored exactly — including an unset one, in which case VS Code's own default applies again.
